**Finding: compliant** (rule T4C — Termination for convenience)

- **§ 9.4** gives Customer an unconditional right to terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause; **§ 29.4** sets that notice period at thirty days.
- Customer owes only accrued Fees — no early-termination fee, penalty, or wind-down charge (confirmed by review of § 7 and § 10), and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (§ 9.4, reinforced by § 10.2).
- Vendor has no convenience right: §§ 9.1–9.2 are mutual for-cause/insolvency rights only, § 9.3 is Customer-only, and § 24.4 expressly bars Vendor from terminating on Customer change of control.

This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
